docs.text: Water restrictions lifted in three Oakland County communities The majority of the water restrictions were issued Thursday, July 16, after a Great Lakes Water Authority pump-station incident, which significantly reduced water flow to Rochester Hills and Oakland Township. GLWA officials have not disclosed specifics of the incident. michigan

If you live in these parts of Oakland County, you need to boil your water Boiled, bottled or disinfected water should be used for drinking, making ice, washing dishes, brushing teeth, and preparing food until further notice. Water should be boiled for at least one minute and then cooled before using for those activities. michigan

Water restrictions increase for some Oakland County communities GLWA has not identified what type of disruption happened at the North Service Center pump station in Troy, but it has led to low water pressure in Auburn Hills, Lake Orion, Orion Township, parts of Oakland Township, the northwest area of Rochester Hills, parts of Troy and Bloomfield Township. Some community messages to residents differed from others. michigan
Boil-water order for some Oakland Township, Rochester Hills residents City officials are asking residents in the affected area to turn off irrigation systems and limit extra water use. michigan

Traverse City area residents told to boil water after system failure The advisory affects East Bay Township customers and is expected to remain in effect for up to 48 hours while water samples are tested. michigan

Boil water advisory lifted for Oakland County communities Residents are advised to flush water systems, replace filters and refresh appliances after the nearly week-long advisory ended. Four other Oakland County communities remain under boil advisories. michigan
Water service restored to five Oakland County communities The four water stations will continue operating until residents in all communities can drink tap water again, he said. michigan

Boil water order Oakland County: Timeline for lifting restrictions Great Lakes Water Authority crews have successfully replaced the 42-inch water main section that broke early Sunday. Boil-water orders remain in effect until further notice. michigan

Oakland County families scramble to help older relatives affected by water main break Fire departments in Orion Township, Rochester Hills, Oakland Township and Auburn Hills ordered businesses to close if water pressure was too low for fire suppressant equipment to work. michigan

Lake Orion schools, restaurants shuttered as water crisis continues The water outage affects all of Orion Township, which includes the Village of Lake Orion, the northwest quadrant of Rochester Hills, and some neighborhoods north of Dutton Road in Oakland Township. Nearby communities have been asked to limit water use to preserve water pressure. michigan

Boil-water advisory impacts thousands as Oakland County watermain repairs begin Eliminating unnecessary water use, such as running dishwashers and washing machines, watering lawns, washing vehicles, filling outdoor pools and other recreational water uses will help preserve water pressure. michigan

Rochester Hills, Oakland Twp. boil-water advisory remains in effect A sudden drop in water pressure Wednesday morning led to a Great Lakes Water Authority (GLWA) order to boil any water for drinking or cooking. michigan

Boil water advisory for parts of Rochester Hills, Oakland Township GLWA officials said the low water pressure raise concerns about potential bacterial contamination and the boil-water advisory was issued out of caution. michigan
Boil water advisory issued after water main break in Ottawa County Road officials say that they anticipate collecting bacterial sample results by 9 a.m., Sunday, May 3. michigan

Week-long boil water advisory in Red Lake, Ont., lifted Tuesday after water main break A week-long boil water advisory has been lifted in the Municipality of Red Lake in northwestern Ontario following a water main break. The municipality-wide advisory was first put in place June 2, prompting the closure of three schools that day.
